title: The Water Content of a CO2-Rich Gas Mixture Containing 5.31 mol % Methane along the Three-Phase and Supercritical Conditions
experimental_method: Equilibrium cell (100 cm3, magnetic pump) with sampling of each phase through heated lines; water analysed by glycerol-packed absorption column and split chromatographic columns with helium carrier (Bloch and Lifland method).
uncertainties_stated: Bath temperature controlled to better than 0.05 C (L&N Pt resistance thermometer, NBS-traceable); pressure transducer certified to better than 0.1 % of full scale (0-3000 psia); accuracy of tabulated water content estimated generally within 5-6 %.
quality_remarks: PDF page 1 begins with another article (LiBr-LiI-water heat capacity, journal page 320 top); this paper starts at the bottom of pdf page 1. Table I row 2 temperature printed 60/15.66 (probably 15.56). Table III (enhancement factors, smoothed pressures and water contents, derived) not extracted.
not_extracted_tables: Table III: enhancement of water partial pressure, E = P y_w/P_w0, with rounded/smoothed pressures and a vapor-pressure calculation; derived
extraction_notes: Text layer matched the image in all cells; text layer columns were interleaved on the left column so cells were typed from the image and cross-checked against the text layer. Temperature and pressure printed as dual units (F/C, psia/MPa), split into separate columns.
